problem: The hasComponent path has the canonical range nltl:shipComponent, but the nested node is constrained only as nltl:benchmarkEntity. This permits a component value that is not typed as the required shipComponent class and imposes the material and curve-type requirements on the wrong class.
required_change: Constrain the nested hasComponent node as nltl:shipComponent, while preserving any separately required benchmarkEntity typing only if it is explicitly supported by the model.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship-owned hasComponent path and ensure its value remains constrained to the canonical nltl:shipComponent range.
